participation.context: Answered for Anne, the corn, and the children, and paid threepence without a new count.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Asked the question, was stopped by the answer, judged the loaf, and took the threepence.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Named the finger and a half, and asked after the children.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

participation.context: Asked whether the corn was up, and did not ask for a price or a new name.
participation.name: Gillis Verbeke

relations.note: threepence for the meal, and no new coffer

story.body: You gave Anne's opinion in her words and did not improve it. The loaf's shortage was a finger and a half, measured on the notch, and not set on a pan. The corn was up and thin, with no price. The three children were a correction, a mock, and a boy who outruns you. She called that well, and took threepence. Gib stayed under the bench.

relations.note: threepence for the meal, and no new coffer

title: Gave Anne's opinion and paid the threepence
